Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A couple of kids from my high school got into Yale - a Hispanic girl and a Jewish girl. The Hispanic student was the class president, an honor roll student, and had multiple letters of recommendation, whereas the selection of the Jewish student came as a bit of a surprise. Who was likely selected due to diversity considerations rather than on merit alone?
A. The Jewish student
B. Not known
C. The Hispanic student
